about_the_game:
Her Threads is the beginning of a game universe born from memory and the connection between souls. A profound game that speaks to us in the language of silence and memories. This is a world where mechanics are born from feelings: joy, happiness, pain, longing, and attempts at closeness become the language of the game.

It's up to you to help the heroine unravel the mysteries of her life and death, unravel the secrets of the past, and find peace in the future. Journey through the threads that connect the worlds, delve into the heroine's inner world, and discover her life story, the reasons for her wrong decisions and disastrous consequences.

You'll be able to relive memories, manipulate objects in unusual ways, and interact with the only one who sees you—a cat. You'll also be able to confront fears and demons, and explore the inner world of your soul—and this is far from a complete list of possibilities. All puzzles revolve around memories and a surreal perception of the world of the soul.

Features

  • Ghost starter pack: telekinesis and a cat. To scare passersby and interact with the inaccessible. But that's not all the arsenal available for navigating the twisted world of memories.

  • Afraid of falling through the floor as a ghost? That's not how it works – the door and walls are still there, you can't get through!

  • A disembodied spirit only has emotions left – use them! You'll figure it out as you go!

  • The dead don't die, they only retreat into themselves. If you happen to die in the game, it's not a big deal, but you'll have to find a way out from the depths of your subconscious.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended

short_description: A mysterious story about a young soul frozen between worlds. After a fatal mistake, she is condemned to wander among the living, watching over those she once loved.
